title: Convergence and combinatorics of the Reverse algorithm
summary: We study the Reverse algorithm, a multidimensional continued fraction algorithm, which is not unimodular. We show that the Reverse algorithm is ergodic and, by proving that its second Lyapunov exponent is negative, that it is a.e. exponentially convergent. In addition to that, we attach substitutions to this algorithm and study the $S$-adic languages generated by sequences of these substitutions.
